title: Taskified admin orchestra and replay harness for lightweight diagnostics
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Problem: Our current incident runbooks are long prose documents and monolithic scripts. First-line responders routinely copy-paste commands, lose context, and struggle to reproduce remediation runs. We need a compact, taskified surface that packages discrete admin actions (idempotent 'snips'), a choreography layer to stitch them for common scenarios, and a deterministic replay harness that captures inputs/outputs for postmortem diagnostics.

Goal: Deliver a lightweight 'orchestra' service + local CLI shim that: 1) exposes atomic admin actions as typed tasks with idempotency guards and well-defined inputs/outputs; 2) supports composing tasks into ephemeral choreographies (parallel/serial flows, conditional gates); 3) records replay traces (inputs, stdout/stderr, exit codes, telemetry) in a structured archive linked to the incident; 4) integrates with existing RBAC and audit logging; 5) provides safe dry-run and guarded execution modes for oncall.

Scope: Minimal viable implementation focused on common support flows (service restart, KV-caching reset, key rotation helpers, log-roll ingestion, connectivity checks). Includes: task schema, lightweight task runner, choreography DSL (YAML), replay archive format, UI hooks (Console incident pane link), and a small set of canonical tasks.

Design decisions/trade-offs:
- Task granularity: prefer smaller atomic 'snips' to maximize reuse; will accept some duplicate plumbing to keep snips simple.
- Language/runtime: implement runner in Go for binary portability and minimal runtime surface; provide Node/TS shim for developer ergonomics.
- State and secrets: tasks accept inputs only and never store secrets in replay archives; use KMS-proxied secrets at runtime.
- Safety: every task runs with capability-limited agents; unsafe tasks require two-person approval and explicit flag.
- Observability: replay archives are stored in S3 (encrypted), with an index entry in the internal incident table to enable fast retrieval from Console.

Deliverables: task registry RFC (Confluence), Go runner v0.1, CLI shim, 8 canonical tasks, replay viewer prototype in Console, integration PRs for audit logging and KMS usage.

References: Confluence RFC: https://redwood.quip.com/X8a1/taskified-admin-orchestra-rfc, design sketches: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ops-orchestra, initial eval PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-harness/pull/128
